questions.text: [10 Cs of Teamwork] An AI product team is developing a new chatbot feature involving data pipelines, model tuning, and front-end integration. Two managers adopt different working styles: 1. Aanchal, the project manager, ensures the team converges on requirements during initial planning meetings. She then divides responsibilities, assigns clear deliverables and timelines, and expects members to work independently on their tasks. Progress is tracked through structured weekly updates to align outputs. 2. Akshay, another manager, engages the user experience designer and engineers in an ongoing iterative process. The team frequently brainstorms ideas together, refines solutions jointly, and addresses challenges in real time to improve chatbot personalization. What best describes the difference between the two approaches?
options: The first approach emphasizes coordination, while the second emphasizes collaboration
The first approach emphasizes collaboration, while the second emphasizes coordination
questions.correct_answer: The first approach emphasizes coordination, while the second emphasizes collaboration
